setupSubtitle: Pick your game, gather your players, take your shot.
x01Short: Count down to a perfect finish.
cricketShort: Close the numbers. Own the board.
x01Rules: Subtract each throw from your starting score. Reach exactly zero. A bust cancels the whole turn. Straight-in; choose straight-out or double-out.
cricketRules: Close 20 through 15 and bull with three marks each. Extra hits score while an opponent has that target open. Close every target and have at least as many points as every opponent to win. Solo: close every target.
clockRules: Hit 1 through 20 in order. Singles, doubles and triples each advance one target. Bull does not count. First to finish wins.
doubleHint: Your final dart must land in a double or inner bull.
straightHint: Any scoring dart can finish the game.
tapHint: Choose a multiplier, then tap a number. Or tap the board.
finishTurn: Enter three darts to finish the turn
bustHint: This turn scores zero. Your starting score is restored.
pausedHint: Your game is paused. Scores are safe while this page stays open.
endHint: This game will be cleared. You can start another straight away.
winnerHint: Good darts. Ready for another round?
correctHint: Select the actual segment hit. Later darts are kept unless the correction ends the turn early.
correctionCleared: The correction ended this turn early; later input was removed.
board: Interactive dartboard. Select a scoring segment.
nameRequired: Enter a name for every player.
gameError: That action is unavailable. Please try again.
adminIntro: Settings are stored on this device. They do not change an active game.
adminFirst: First use: create an admin password. It protects settings on this local device.
adminLogin: Enter your admin password to manage this device.
memoryNotice: Games live only in memory. Refreshing this page, closing the browser or losing power clears the game.
cameraFutureHint: Not installed. This version uses manual entry; the input adapter is ready for a later camera service.
serviceUnavailable: Settings service is unavailable. Games still work with defaults.
authError: Could not unlock settings. Check the password and try again.
saveError: Could not save settings. Please try again.
weakPassword: Use a password with at least 8 characters.
retryLater: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
sessionExpired: Admin session expired. Please unlock settings again.
quitFullscreen: Use Escape to leave full screen
themeNote: Built for your board. Works without the internet.
killerShort: Arm yourself. Be the last standing.
halveitShort: Hit the target. Protect your score.
killerRules: Doubles-only Killer, for 2–6 players. Assign each player a unique number from 1 to 20 before starting; you can enter numbers chosen by an off-hand throw. Everyone starts with three lives. Hit your own double once to become a Killer; this arming dart does not remove a life. From your next dart, each hit on another player’s double removes one of their lives. Once armed, hitting your own double also costs you one life. Singles, triples, bull and unassigned numbers have no effect. Killer status is permanent. Eliminated players are skipped; self-elimination ends your turn immediately. The last surviving player wins, even if not yet armed.
shanghaiRules: Seven rounds, targeting 1 through 7 in order. Each player throws three darts at the current number; only that number scores, with normal single/double/triple values. Hitting its single, double and triple in one turn, in any order, is a Shanghai and wins immediately. Otherwise, the highest total after every player completes round 7 wins. Equal highest totals share the win. Solo play finishes with a Shanghai or after round 7.
halveitRules: Start at 40 points. Each player throws three darts at each target in this nine-round sequence: 15, 16, any numbered double, 17, 18, any triple, 19, 20, bull. Only matching hits add their normal points. Both outer bull (25) and inner bull (50) count in the bull round; inner bull does not count as a numbered double. Missing the target with all three darts halves your running score after the third dart, rounded down to a whole number. The highest score after everyone completes bull wins; tied leaders share the win. Solo play completes all nine rounds.
killerNumbersHint: Each player owns one different number. You can use numbers chosen by a preliminary off-hand throw.
armInstruction: Hit D{n} to become a Killer.
attackInstruction: Hit opponents’ doubles. Your own double costs a life.
halveWarning: Hit this target at least once, or your score is halved.
invalidKillerNumbers: Choose a different number from 1 to 20 for every player.
adminKillerCount: Killer requires at least two players in the defaults.
